summary: @or-sdk/view-templates preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated in-tree payload
details: Package @or-sdk/view-templates@2.2.5 declares a `preinstall` lifecycle hook that runs `setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads a pinned Bun runtime tarball from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` against the package-local `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-bundled script that is heavily obfuscated with a string-array rotator/decoder (functions `WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9`, numeric array `n7gIxM`) reconstructing all strings at runtime; no destinations, imports, or purpose are visible in plaintext. `setup.mjs` itself uses obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming (`_0xNNNNN`) and property-lookup indirection (`_0x19328d.YCZJE(execFileSync,...)`) to disguise the download/exec control flow. The package is advertised as an SDK view-templates library; there is no declared need for a second language runtime to install a template library. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated blob at install time — rather than to build or run declared native components — is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the executed code is not the runtime's own source but shipped obfuscated bytes whose behavior cannot be reviewed statically, and the choice of Bun bypasses Node-only install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
